about_the_game:
Embark on an epic journey through the cursed realm of Elythar in Hallowed Veil: The Last Prince, that blends intense combat, exploration, and a gripping narrative. As the last knight of a fallen order, uncover the dark secrets of a once-vibrant world now shrouded in corruption. Explore haunting ruins, ancient castles, treacherous caves, and enchanted forests, battling twisted creatures born of an insidious curse.

Key Features:

  • Rich Storyline: Dive into a single-player campaign filled with lore and mystery. Twists and betrayals. Uncover the truth behind Elythar’s fall through dialogue and pivotal choices.

  • Dynamic Combat System: Engage in combat against twisted creatures and formidable bosses. Wield a sacred blade, dual swords, or heavy, impactful weapons like battle axes, each with unique move sets. Master parrying, dodging, and combo attacks with precise timing to outwit enemies.

  • Exploration and Environments: Traverse hand-crafted landscapes, from haunting ruins and ancient castles to treacherous caves and enchanted forests, all rendered in stunning detail using Unreal Engine. Solve mysteries, uncover lost relics, and piece together the history of Elythar’s fallen kingdom through hidden lore.

  • Playstyles: Enhance your knight through a progression system that lets you equip enchanted artifacts that grant abilities that increase your power or armor, and choose weapons—dual swords for agility or heavy weapons for raw power—to suit your playstyle.

  • Immersive Atmosphere: Experience a hauntingly beautiful world brought to life with Unreal engine. Every castle, cave, and forest is designed to draw you deeper into Elythar’s cursed veil.

content_descriptors.notes: Hallowed Veil: The Last Prince features intense weapon-based combat with graphic violence and blood. Players slash, impale, and slice cursed creatures, with blood splatters. The dark fantasy narrative includes themes of loss, despair, and war. No sexual content, drug abuse, or self-harm is depicted, but emotional distress may be triggering. Recommended for mature players.
